request: Hey Claude, I just added the "social-giveaway-planner" skill. Plan our fall giveaway on Instagram, Facebook and X. I was thinking: comment, tag 2 friends, follow us, and share to your Story or Timeline for an extra entry. Then pick the 3 winners when it closes, and 30 days later tell me what it left behind. Follower ads cost us about $1 a follower, so that's the bar.
